name: Greater Paralysis (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Paralysis, Ability Focus (paralysis), Improved Paralysis

Benefit(s): Any living creature you paralyze is paralyzed permanently. Remove paralysis or any spell that can remove a curse can free the victim (see the bestow curse spell description, with a DC equal to your save DC). The effect cannot be dispelled. Anyone paralyzed by you seems dead, though a DC 20 Perception check or a DC 15 Heal check reveals that the victim is still alive. In addition, those that successfully save against your paralysis are staggered for 1 round. An opponent that succeeds on the saving throw is staggered for one round and after that is immune to this staggered effect for 24 hours.
